text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... thanks, Big Brother.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... thanks, Big Sister.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I could hear everyone's voices while I
was running.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
You can do it! "Go, Rice, go!" Everyone
was
urging me onward.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, this isn't right. I promised I would
make
everyone smile...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: But I'm the one who can't stop smiling!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Sniffle... I'm so glad that I got to run in the Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...They do?
choice_data_list: みんなも同じことを思ってるよ

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Riiiice! Thank yooou!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: This was the best Takarazuka Kinen ever!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Wow! There are happy faces
everywhere!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Because of... me?
choice_data_list: この笑顔を守ったのは君だよ
この笑顔を守ったのは貴方だよ

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... there's no way. The blue rose
brings
happiness, not misfortune, the
way I do.
choice_data_list: 君はみんなにとっての青いバラだ
貴方はみんなにとっての青いバラだよ

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It would take someone really special to
make
everyone smile like—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
choice_data_list: ほら、今のライスと同じだ

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Oh! That means... I... did it...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I brought happiness to everyone!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Nnng... Waaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She bursts into tears, shoulders
quivering, while
the audience warmly
applauds her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At night...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Inhale... exhale...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Heh, yeah. I can't just keep crying
forever.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I have to smile at everyone while I'm up
onstage,
after all.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
That way I can show them how thankful I
am to
have their support.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
And that tonight, I'll bring them all
happiness.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Is that too much?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Thank goodness! If you say so, then I'm
sure it's
fine.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Thank goodness! If you say so, then I'm
sure it's
fine.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Well then, I'm off! I have to go see
everyone.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Thanks!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Rice Shower puts on her best
winning
concert performance yet.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next day, a large picture of her
graces the
front page of the newspaper.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And thus blooms on Yodo turf a
beautiful blue
rose—a new star, Rice
Shower.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next day...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
B-Big Brother! I want to run in the Arima
Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
B-Big Sister! I want to run in the Arima
Kinen!
choice_data_list: もう新しい目標を決めたのか！？
もう新しい目標を決めたの！？

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yes! You see, I heard...
choice_data_list: もう新しい目標を決めたのか！？
もう新しい目標を決めたの！？

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Bourbon and McQueen are racing there!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
So I want to join too! It'll be the ultimate
race!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yay! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yay! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Like the Takarazuka Kinen, the Arima
Kinen is a
race in which only the most
popular runners can
participate.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To think, she's now able to say she wants
to
participate without worrying about
the
requirements. Which means...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh? Did I get taller?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Then, what do you mean?
choice_data_list: そういうことじゃないよ

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: T-tell me, Big Brother!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: T-tell me, Big Sister!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower spends the rest of the day
following
me around, pestering me for
an answer.
